issues.description: Method SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery: the problem statement (UML and textual description) declares a four-parameter signature acceptSupplyDelivery(String supplierName, String ingredientName, int price, int quantity), but the code examples and reference implementation use a three-parameter signature acceptSupplyDelivery(String ingredientName, int price, int quantity). This mismatch in parameter count/ordering across the problem specification and the code will confuse students about the correct method signature to implement and call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the acceptSupplyDelivery signature consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: update the problem statement (UML and textual description) to declare acceptSupplyDelivery(String ingredientName, int price, int quantity) since the supplier name is not used by the template or reference solution. Alternatively, if supplier information is required pedagogically, update the template example and the reference implementation to accept four parameters (String supplierName, String ingredientName, int price, int quantity) and use or store the supplier parameter accordingly.
